name: a standing stone
description: A stone the size of a person stands here, where somebody put it, a long time ago, and the room has been arranged around it ever since without anybody noticing.
looks: Marked by hands over a duration you cannot hold.
It is warm on one side, and it is not the side facing the light.
It has weight the way a word has meaning.
says: I have been here longer than the road.
Somebody stood exactly there, for a very good reason.
emotes: {it} stands there taking up the exact centre of the room, which it did not seem to be doing before.
The shadow of {it} points somewhere the light cannot account for.
asks: Do you know who put me here?
Which way is north? You should know that.
